book.name: 1 Timatio
book.title: Ŋwa' wvu fwe wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ Timatio

content: Fiɛɛ fi fwe fì me nlɛke nu lɛ, bonyii bo Nyo' le ebunleè fô bonyii le bocii. Bó ebunleè beelè fô Nyo' le bvuu lɛkè Nyo' fô bonyii bomew e, nyaà tɛn keyoone ɛ̂ wvú.

Bó ebunleè fô bonfon e, bô fô bonyii le bocii bò nu yî bintaw bi baay baay e. Bó ebunleè nonɛn wvu lɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ beene eceè nce kenlɛɛtɛn bô wvu nyɛkeey noo wvu bonyii bo Nyo' le noo wvù kɛŋke n'wvum.
Keebunlee nonɛn nu fiɛɛ fì jee, ɛ fí ɛ kocɛn ɛjise jo Nyo' wvù Mboyse wesebeene,
wvù shieele lɛ wee tfuu ke eboy noo lɛ wee tfuu ekeè kecɛɛy e.
Nyo' nu kɛ mwaaŋ maaŋ, ɛ wee wvù nu ɛntelɛŋ jo Nyo' bô bonyii nu kɛ tɛn mwaaŋ. Ɛ wee wvun nu Klistu Jisos.
Ɛ̀ nu wvú wvù to nyaɛ ɛkolɛ kew keesum bonyii bocii yî ŋgɛw e. Fifin nu fiɛɛ fì Nyo' to duŋcɛɛ seke kefew ke lɛŋ to kocɛnɛɛ.

Ɛ̀ nɛɛ fiɛɛ fì Nyo' to balɛɛ me lɛ me enù wee nfewcɛ noo waa ntum Jisos bô lɛ me enù wee n'yɛɛyi bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu keen'yɛɛyi bó ɛ́ bó elese fitele yî Klistu le, eyɛɛyi tɛn bó bô kecɛɛy. Kɛ fiɛɛ fì me njemyi fin nu ɛ me mbiayte lo kɛ. Me njemyi ɛ ɛ̀ nu kecɛɛy.
Me ɛ mum ɛ no nshieele lɛ bolemsɛ ebunleè mondvuum e monciim, cawse ɛ ɛ̀ nu can yì yuule we yaa ton'yi shém kɛnɛɛ cɛwkene kɛ.

Me nshieele tɛn lɛ bokɛnɛ ejiisè ndvú ɛ̂ je yi lɛŋ e yì duŋci n'wvum e, noo ɛ̂ yì bonyii yɛne lɛ ɛ̀ nu yi lɛŋ e. Fo bó etuwcì bikuu kɛnɛɛ leese mwɛɛm mvù bó kene bô ketwaa ke bigew e kè yɛɛle kɛnɛɛ ɛjisɛ ɛ baŋ, kɛnɛɛ ndvú yi kenlum e kɛ.
Bó esuutè ye yibo ɛ ɛ̀ nu bô gee dì jee diɛwɛ bokɛnɛ bò nu ɛ kocɛn keebunlee Nyo' le.
Kpwoon kɛŋke keenya ɛkolɛ kew keeyeke lo n'yɛɛyi, nu diuw tfu.
Me mbaa nya je lɛ kpwoon eyɛɛyì bolemsɛ kɛnɛɛ ekɛŋke mvuŋgay ɛ̂ we jo bolemsɛ kɛ. Wvú kɛŋke keenu diuw tfu.
Fí nu nonɛn njefo ɛ̀ nu Adam wvù Nyo' to yawɛɛ bom, sɛ bom Iff.
Ɛ kɛ ɛ̀ yaa nu Adam wvù Satan to lɛlɛɛ kɛ. Ɛ̀ nu kpwoon wvù bó to lɛlɛɛ ɛ wvú ŋgoy nci Nyo'.

Naa no fí cim nu nonɛn, nu ɛ Nyo' nu ke eboyse kpwoon fele yî boom bò wvú boote le, fɛn ɛ́ wvú ɛ mɛy ɛ no leeme yî fitele fì wvú lese yî Nyo' le, kɛŋke keŋkoŋɛn, cee nce wvù yuule noo wvù kɛŋke n'wvum e.
